1934, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 250 Cont.
Oct. 18 Sarcomic Cancer. Blood Cancer. Hazel Marg. Doreen - Wellwood - 17 - n. Cath. - cancer of the hip ... had pneumonia, was operated on ... then fearful pains in legs ... operated on again and found to be hopelessly cancerous. Enrolled last Thursday (October 18) for one year by discouraged parents when all the doctors agreed there was 22 nothing they could do .... To-night the parents return to say the child was brighter - even sitting up when they went home that night. Now every indication she is improving and will be cured.
Nov. 2 - worse - phone call about 9 P.M. 104 2/10 fever - pulse 158 - little hope for over-night. 3rd - rests well after mother phones. Nov. 3rd. a.m. pulse 118 - fever only 102 3/10 Deo Gr. - Nov. 4 9:30 P.M. - Very hopeful Nov. 11 still astonishingly improving. Nov. 18 Mother here to-night. Thank God girl astonishingly better. Dec. 8 Parents here to-night ... Hazel without pain all day. Great hopes now of
Page 251 Oct. 18 S. Cancer - Continuation - Dec. 28 - continued from October 18 (Page ahead) Mrs. Wellwood - Hazel's mother - called up." ..... Hazel died yesterday at 4:30 a.m.
P.S. So far the foregoing has been disapointing. Last Sunday Fr. Sol. gently but earnestly urged said Mr. W. to get busy at their promise to look into religion as proposed two months and 9 days ago, if girl were spared. She half heartedly pro.
Page 252 Oct. Geo & Eliz. Power - very sick - phone call for prayers. Henry & Walter LeCroix - for just remuneration ..... want to get on farm. James Harvey Donahue .... steel in eye.
Mrs. Sliker - asks to thank God that daughter has given up undesirable company - prayed for a year ago.
Ch's Col. DeMers - 74 - Aug. 17th - Sarcomic cancer 8 yrs. ago ... cured ... 2 yrs. ago fearful gall-stones and gravel ... working now as a man of 35. Laments two of his children have dropped faith.
Mrs. Mary Mahady - Elderly Gr.Mother "dying" last Thursday ... better but still in dying condition.
